changeSet.author: registration-integrity
changeSet.comment: UPDATE by name rather than delete-and-insert: tournament_categories.template_id references these rows, and name carries uq_tournament_category_templates_name.

changeSet.author: registration-integrity
changeSet.comment: Skips any category with a confirmed entrant. Those keep the band they were created with; an organiser can still correct one by hand from Settings.
changeSet.sql: WITH settled AS ( SELECT DISTINCT category_id FROM tournament_registrations WHERE category_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'confirmed' ) UPDATE tournament_categories c SET min_rating = v.new_min, max_rating = v.new_max, updated_at = now() FROM (VALUES (NULL::numeric, 2.5::numeric, 2.0::numeric, 2.4::numeric), (2.5, 3.0, 2.5, 2.9), (3.5, 4.5, 3.6, 4.5), (4.5, 5.5, 4.6, 5.5), (5.5, NULL, 5.6, NULL) ) AS v(old_min, old_max, new_min, new_max) WHERE c.min_rating IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.old_min AND c.max_rating IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v.old_max AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM settled s WHERE s.category_id = c.id);

rollback.comment: Not reversed. The forward direction is lossy - a category whose band already equalled the new values is indistinguishable from one this changeset moved - so an automated reversal would corrupt bands it never touched. Restore from a backup if this genuinely needs undoing.

changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tournament_registrations_one_per_category BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF player_id, partner_player_id, category_id, status ON tournament_registrations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_assert_one_entry_per_category();
